programme.title: Carabao Cup: Wrexham v Cardiff
programme.desc: Wrexham v Cardiff City (Kick-off 8.00pm). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the fourth-round match at StoK Racecourse, as the Welsh rivals face each other for the first time since the 2001/02 season. Big-spending Wrexham were minutes away from being eliminated by Hull City in the first round, but an injury-time brace from Ollie Palmer inspired them to a penalty shootout victory, before they went on to defeat Preston North End and Reading in the following rounds. Meanwhile, the Bluebirds registered routine wins over Swindon Town and Cheltenham Town before recording a cup upset over Premier League Burnley in round three, with first-half goals by Joel Colwill and Callum Robinson inspiring a 2-1 triumph at Turf Moor. Commentary comes from Sam Matterface and Stephen Warnock, with analysis by Steven Fletcher and Robert Earnshaw, and reports from Gabriel Clarke

programme.desc: Wrexham v Cardiff City (Kick-off 8.00pm). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the fourth-round match at StoK Racecourse, as the Welsh rivals face each other for the first time since the 2001/02 season. Big-spending Wrexham were minutes away from being eliminated by Hull City in the first round, but an injury-time brace from Ollie Palmer inspired them to a penalty shootout victory, before they went on to defeat Preston North End and Reading in the following rounds. Meanwhile, the Bluebirds registered routine wins over Swindon Town and Cheltenham Town before recording a cup upset over Premier League Burnley in round three, with first-half goals by Joel Colwill and Callum Robinson inspiring a 2-1 triumph at Turf Moor. Commentary comes from Sam Matterface and Stephen Warnock, with analysis by Steven Fletcher and Robert Earnshaw, and reports from Gabriel Clarke

The build-up has been intense - as two of the best jockeys in the saddle also go head-to-head, who will triumph?

programme.title: Strip Tease Murder
programme.desc: 1961. Crime. Director: Ernest Morris. Stars John Hewer, Ann Lynn & Jean Muir. A dancer collapses and dies on stage at the famous Flamingo Club leading her husband to delve into the investigation.

programme.title: EuroTrash
programme.desc: 1993. Hosted by Antoine de Caunes and Jean Paul Gaultier. Watch an interview with Ellen Von Unwerth, one of the world's top fashion photographers! And we find out who won the Bravo magazine award.

programme.title: A Saint, A Woman, A Devil
programme.desc: 1977. Drama. Director: Peter Savage. Stars Joanna Bell, Marc Stevens & Sonny Landham. Sylvia is a seemingly quiet and saintly person. But she is hiding a promiscuous multiple personality disorder.

programme.title: Moon of the Wolf
programme.desc: 1972. Horror. Director: Daniel Petrie. Stars: David Janssen, Barbara Rush & Bradford Dillman. A werewolf may be stalking the Bayou, forcing Whitaker to confront superstition and deadly reality.

programme.title: Midnight Fear
programme.desc: 1990. Crime thriller directed by Bill Crain and starring David Carradine, Pete Atkins and Mark Carlton. Detective Hanks must track down two psychotic killers before they kill again.

programme.title: Bulldog Drummond's Secret Police
programme.desc: 1939. Mystery. Director: James Hogan. Stars John Howard, Heather Angel & H.B. Warner. Captain Drummond plans to marry his girlfriend but a hidden treasure on his estate complicates the situation.

programme.title: Singing Through
programme.desc: 1935. Comedy. Directed by Max Mack. Stars Bobbie Comber, Bertha Belmore & Cecil Ramage. A rural man is duped into schemes that lead him to London.

programme.title: Things to Come
programme.desc: 1936. Sci-fi. Director: William Cameron Menzies. Stars Raymond Massey, Edward Chapman & Ralph Richardson. Futuristic story about the devastation and struggles of society after a decades-long war.

programme.title: Look At Life What's On The Roof
programme.desc: 1960. A detailed look at roofing in London and across the country, with a focus on traditional roofing crafts, various types of roofs for different buildings and how the work is completed.

programme.title: Orders Are Orders
programme.desc: 1954. Comedy. An American film crew are making a film in a British army camp, but the soldiers chase the film unit's girls. Starring Tony Hancock, Sid James & Peter Sellers.

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
programme.desc: Jed Gets the Misery. 1963. Stars Buddy Ebsen, Irene Ryan & Donna Douglas. Jed fakes an illness so Granny can doctor him but soon enough Mr. Drysdale and his doctor become subject to her methods.

programme.title: The Kansan
programme.desc: 1943. Western. Directed by George Archainbaud. Stars Richard Dix, Jane Wyatt & Albert Dekker. A cowboy's life takes a turn after he stops a gang of thieves from robbing a bank in the town.

programme.title: Worzel Gummidge
programme.desc: The Golden Hind. 1981. Stars Jon Pertwee, Bernard Cribbins & Una Stubbs. When a new fish and chip shop opens, Worzel becomes friends with the figurehead, Jolly Jack - until Aunt Sally comes along.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: That Darn Catwoman. 1967. Stars Adam West, Burt Ward & Alan Napier. Catwoman mind controls Robin! The Caped Crusader must stop her before she does who knows what with him!

programme.title: Berth 24
programme.desc: 1950. Director: J.B Holmes. With William Devlin and Richard Huson. First production of the new British Transport Film Unit. In the Hull Docks, the steamer S.S. Bravo arrives from Gothenburg with cargo

programme.title: The Intruder (1953)
programme.desc: 1953. Drama. Director: Guy Hamilton. Stars Jack Hawkins, Dennis Price, Michael Medwin, George Cole & Hugh Williams. An ex Colonel catches one of his former men robbing his house and investigates.

programme.title: The Vise
programme.desc: The Benevolent Burglar. 1955. Stars James Hayter, Ron Randell & Peter Dyneley. Detective Mark Tower falls for Lady Carol. When she receives his love letters there can be only one suspect.

programme.title: The Footage Detectives
programme.desc: Noel and Mike are joined by the legendary Eddy Grant! Do you remember the Welsh band The Cheatin' Hearts? And Jean Frame has been in touch after seeing herself in our film Serious Charge.

programme.title: The 39 Steps (1959)
programme.desc: 1959. Thriller. Directed by Ralph Thomas. Stars Kenneth More, Taina Elg & Brenda de Banzie. A diplomat is inadvertently involved in the death of a spy, fleeing to Scotland to search for clues.

programme.title: Look At Life Women with Leisure
programme.desc: 1960. A look into the popularity of ten-pin bowling, especially among women, with glimpses of the new bowling centre on the pier in Southend and a centre for travellers and staff at London Airport.

programme.title: Memories of Making Sergeant Cork
programme.desc: Acclaimed actor William Gaunt discusses Sergeant Cork's studio & sets.

programme.title: Sergeant Cork
programme.desc: The Case of the Sleepy Coachmen. 1963. Stars John Barrie, William Gaunt & Rosalie Crutchley. The laundry maid is found dead in the stables, but how did the coachmen sleep through her murder?

programme.title: Who Do You Do?
programme.desc: 1972. With Freddie Starr and Peter Goodwright, guest acts Barry Cryer, Margo Henderson and Peter Cavanagh play a number of roles in a series of sketches and songs!

programme.title: So Evil, So Young
programme.desc: 1961. Drama. Director: Godfrey Grayson. Stars Jill Ireland, Ellen Pollock & John Charlesworth. Framed for robbery and sent to a reform school, a young girl becomes the target of a vicious warden.

programme.title: Twist or Stick
programme.desc: It's a 1960s twisting compilation see 'The Hollies' Shane Fenton & The Fentones, The Orchids, The Keytones, a lot of 'That Old Yeah, Yeah Feeling' and much more.

programme.title: The Heritage Chart Show with Mike Read
programme.desc: A TOTP style TV Show for Heritage Artists based on the Heritage Chart which is voted on in over 80 countries. Songs you love from popular artists, live and on video with the odd interview.

programme.title: Echo Of Diana
programme.desc: 1963. Joan is distraught at the death of her husband in a plane crash but all is not what it seems. Stars: Vincent Ball & Betty McDowall.

programme.title: Men In War
programme.desc: 1957. War. Director: Anthony Mann. Stars Robert Ryan, Robert Keith, Aldo Ray & Vic Morrow. During the Korean War, Lt. Benson and his troops find a colonel experiencing psychological combat trauma.

programme.title: The Curse of the Wraydons
programme.desc: 1946. Horror. A young captain, after participating in a duel, becomes the suspect in a series of killings near Epping Forest. Directed by Victor M Gover. Starring Tod Slaughter & Bruce Seton.

programme.title: Johnny Ringo
programme.desc: Die Twice. Directed by Aaron Spelling. Starring Don Durant. Ringo requests the exhumation of Boone Hackett's grave. Ringo later has reason to believe Boone's spirit is continuing his career.

programme.title: Web of Evidence
programme.desc: 1959. Thriller. Director: Jack Cardiff. Stars Van Johnson, Vera Miles, Bernard Lee & Jean Kent. A WW2 evacuee returns years later to England and finds his father in prison and framed for murder.

programme.title: What's On TPTV With Noel
programme.desc: Founder of Talking Pictures TV and one half of the Footage Detectives, Noel Cronin, shares shows and films not to be missed throughout November.

programme.title: Out of Town
programme.desc: Observing the Country/Working Dog Show. 1981. Jack looks for fallow and roe deer and other wildlife from a seat high in the trees. It's then on to a working dog show climaxing with a terrier race.

programme.title: The Spider and the Fly
programme.desc: 1949. Crime. Directed by Robert Hamer. Stars Eric Portman, Nadia Gray & George Cole. An unusual love triangle develops between two criminals and a policeman on the eve of the first World War.

programme.title: Rumpole of the Bailey
programme.desc: Rumpole and the Younger Generation. Stars: Leo McKern, Peggy Thorpe-Bates & David Yelland. Rumpole successfully defends a teenager accused of robbery with violence.

programme.title: Z-Cars
programme.desc: Pressure. 1974. Stars Lynda Bellingham, Peter Birchall & Ian Cullen. A young petty thief and a young Police Constable find themselves under a similar kind of pressure - to prove themselves.

programme.title: The Small Back Room
programme.desc: 1949. Drama. Directors Michael Powell, Emeric Pressburger. Stars David Farrar, Jack Hawkins and Kathleen Byron. The best bomb disposal expert must battle his inner self, during the German raids.

programme.title: Cover Girl Killer
programme.desc: 1959. Crime. Someone is murdering cover girl models, leaving them in the same pose and place as featured in 'Wow' magazine. Stars: Harry H. Corbett, Felicity Young.

programme.title: Look At Life Down London River
programme.desc: 1962. A Look into a leisurely journey through London along the Thames.

programme.title: Scotland Yard
programme.desc: 1961. The Never Never Murder. Directed by Peter Duffell. Starring Russell Napier, Genine Graham and Maurice Good. A dead body sets the police on the track of a fraudster. (S1, E37)

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: Denver McKee. 1960. Stars Dan Blocker, Franchot Tone & Natalie Trundy. Ranchers are being killed and cattle is stolen. Denver McKee leads various groups after the suspects but never finds them.

programme.title: The Vise
programme.desc: The Benevolent Burglar. 1955. Stars James Hayter, Ron Randell & Peter Dyneley. Detective Mark Tower falls for Lady Carol. When she receives his love letters there can be only one suspect.

programme.title: The Footage Detectives
programme.desc: Mike & Noel share some 1960s wedding nostalgia, they've found a great old ice cream advert featuring someone very special & there's some very important words from our dear friend Pete Murray.

programme.title: Francis Durbridge's The Doll
programme.desc: The Doll Part 1. 1975. Stars John Fraser, Anouska Hempel & Geoffrey Whitehead. The beautiful Phyllis Du Salle disappears and Peter Matty will stop at nothing to find her.

programme.title: Gideon's Way
programme.desc: The Big Fix. Directed by James Hill. Stars John Gregson, Michael Ripper, Penelope Horner, Maurice Hedley & Robert Brown. Gideon investigates after a horse who is favourite to win loses a race.

programme.title: The Lineup
programme.desc: 1958. Crime. Directed by Don Siegel. Stars Eli Wallach, Robert Keith & Richard Jaeckel. A ruthless hitman is sent to recover packages of drugs hidden inside the luggage of unsuspecting travellers.

programme.title: A Month of Sundays
programme.desc: 1989. Drama/Comedy. Directed by Allan Kroeker. Stars Hume Cronyn, Vincent Gardenia & Tandy Cronyn. A perceptive drama by award-winning playwright Bob Larbey, about coming to terms with old age.

programme.title: The System
programme.desc: 1964. Drama. Director: Michael Winner. Stars Oliver Reed, Jane Merrow & Barbara Ferris. On the British coast, the local young men mingle among the summer's tourists in search of sexual conquests.

programme.title: Quicksand
programme.desc: 1950. Crime Drama. Directed by Irving Pichel. Stars Mickey Rooney, Jeanne Cagney & Barbara Bates. After borrowing money, a mechanic encounters ever more devastating situations that lead him to crime.
